description.zh: 宿主按 插件覆盖值 > 所选 provider > 全局默认 的顺序解析出一份本插件专用配置
description.en: The host resolves a plugin-private config as plugin override > selected provider > global default

hint.zh: 留空使用全局默认。下拉列表来自这套部署实际配置的 provider，不是写死在本文件里的
hint.en: Empty uses the global default. The list comes from what this deployment actually has configured, not from this file

hint.zh: 留空则沿用所选 provider 的模型；候选随上面选的 provider 联动
hint.en: Empty keeps the selected provider's model; the choices follow the provider picked above

hint.zh: 超出的旧笔记由 /actions/prune 清理
hint.en: Older notes beyond this are removed by the prune action

hint.zh: 子智能体投票时低于该分数判为 reject
hint.en: The voting subagent rejects anything scoring below this

hint.zh: 多行文本，发给模型前会拼上笔记正文
hint.en: Multi-line; the note body is appended before it reaches the model

summary_prompt.default: Summarise the following notes into a short outline. Reply in the language of the notes.

description.zh: 密钥请走环境变量。secret 字段只是在表单里打码，落盘的仍是明文
description.en: Prefer environment variables. A secret field only masks the input; it is stored in clear text

hint.zh: list 渲染成一串可增删的文本行
hint.en: A list renders as repeatable text rows

hint.zh: dict 渲染成可增删的键值对
hint.en: A dict renders as editable key/value pairs

hint.zh: template_list 的 items 描述每一行的子表单
hint.en: A template_list uses items to describe the sub-form of one row

hint.zh: file 的值也是一个列表；解析这些路径时请用 storage.resolve / storage.user_file
hint.en: A file value is a list too; resolve the paths with storage.resolve / storage.user_file

hint.zh: invisible 字段不出现在表单里，但会进 plugin.config，适合放迁移标记
hint.en: An invisible field is hidden from the form but still lands in plugin.config - good for migration markers
